definition: An informal term for a group of infrastructure products from HashiCorp used together to provision, secure, network, or run services.
entry_text: An informal term for a group of infrastructure products from HashiCorp used together to provision, secure, network, or run services.
example: An infrastructure team combines infrastructure provisioning and secrets management tools in a deployment workflow.
label: HashiStack
sense_note: The exact products included vary with the organization.
